note: Questions mirror the live Gravity Forms medical assessment (6 steps). Change wording here, not in templates. 'showIf' hides a question until another answer matches; 'rules' block progress with a message.
intro: We need this questionnaire before we can supply prescription and high-strength treatments, including minoxidil, finasteride, dutasteride, spironolactone and Roseway Labs tonics. It takes about 5–10 minutes and asks about your hair loss, health, medication history and contact details so our prescriber can approve your prescription. You won’t need to repeat it for repeat orders.

steps.title: Treatment
steps.description: Please answer every question honestly and in full. Your answers are treated in the strictest confidence and are only shared with the prescriber responsible for your care.

steps.title: Review & consent
steps.description: Please check your answers, then read and accept the statements below.
statements: By agreeing to these terms, I acknowledge that my personal information will be disclosed to the prescriber responsible for approving my prescription. I understand that the prescriber may need to contact me to discuss my medical history or address any concerns related to my prescription.
I understand that I would need to take the treatment for at least 3–6 months before I see any benefit, and stopping treatment will reverse any regrowth and hair loss will resume.

I understand that my prescription is customised specifically for me and is an unlicensed medication. Unless directed otherwise, the prescriber will send this prescription directly to Compounding Lab Ltd T/A Compounding Chemist, who will compound the medication to the standards underpinned in Section 10 of the Medicines Act 1968.

I confirm that I have understood the questions asked, have answered them honestly, and that this treatment is for myself only. I understand the side effects, other treatment options available, and that I can contact the prescriber for more information.
The risks and potential side effects associated with medications have been explained to me, and I have had the opportunity to ask any questions concerning this treatment.
Medications will be delivered to the address confirmed at the time of order.
Medications will be delivered through a tracked courier service.

My confidential information will be processed and used for the above services under current data protection requirements, which may include record keeping. If I would like to change or withdraw my authorisation for any of the above services, I can contact a member of the pharmacy team on info@cchemist.com or 0203 7732 729.

questions.label: I have read and agree to the statements above.
I am happy for Hair Medics UK to share my data with Compounding Lab Ltd (trading as Compounding Chemist) to process my prescription.
